newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan PM says no change in ties with France.
newsitem.headline: Japan PM says no change in ties with France.

text.p: Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto said on Monday he had no comment on the leftist victory in the French general elections but said there will be no change in Japan's ties with France.
"I will offer no comment since it is the choice of the French people," Hashimoto told reporters. "We have no desire to change ties (with France)."
Led by the Socialist party, the French left-wing opposition scored a stunning victory in Sunday's second round of general elections.

French government sources said Prime Minister Alain Juppe would tender his resignation to President Jacques Chirac on Monday morning following the defeat and Socialist leader Lionel Jospin would be appointed to succeed him immediately.
